description: This PHP source file defines a plugin class for the Revive Adserver, specifically an invocation tag plugin for embedding iFrame ads with configurable options and code generation logic.

classes.name: Plugins_InvocationTags_OxInvocationTags_adframe
classes.description: A plugin class for generating iframe ad tags with configurable options and invocation code.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the translated name of the plugin ('iFrame Tag').

methods.name: getNameEN
methods.description: Returns the English name of the plugin ('iFrame Tag').

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if the plugin is allowed based on extra parameters and parent class logic.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order priority of the plugin (fixed to 2).

methods.name: getOptionsList
methods.description: Provides a list of configurable options for the plugin.

methods.name: generateInvocationCode
methods.description: Generates the iframe invocation HTML code with dynamic parameters and options.
